card.what: Laminated wooden tiller of a small keelboat: varnished ash and mahogany laminations, rectangular with eased edges, rising from the rudder head to a rounded grip, carried on the rudder head's pivot bolt by two stainless side straps
card.boats: J/22 (Tools/boatkit/layouts/j22.json at RudderStock; the hero J/22 draws its own in Inputs/j22-hero/j22_steering.py from the same photos), Catalina 22 and other small keelboats with a wooden tiller
card.distance: arm's reach: the helm holds it, and the cockpit camera looks straight down it
card.before: kit Tiller from bk_parts.tiller (Oct 2026): one swept bar in a single varnish, a plain aluminium box for a head, a black knob on the end

references.use: the look in use on the J/22 Bean sails at Rush Creek: deep varnished butt between silver straps, broad pale ash with darker strips, a gentle S rising off the head, rounded grip end
references.url: Bean's lesson photos (Data/Reference/raw/j22-lessons/IMG_9271, IMG_9273; people in frame, so never in a sheet) and his tiller photos used for Inputs/j22-hero/j22_steering.py (LAMS)

references.note: Rudder Craft J/22 tiller (style B): 47 in long, butt 2 in high by 1.5 in wide, 4.75 in rise; style A 43 in with 9.75 in rise. H&L J/22 tiller: butt 2.25 in, alternating 1/4 in mahogany and ash strips (owner report, sailboatowners.com)

sizes.name: Overall, the straps' round front to the grip's end (strap end 21 mm + 85 mm to the butt + the 47 in tiller)
sizes.source: catalogue 1194 mm tiller; strap reach as the hero J/22's (STRAP_IN 85 mm)

sizes.name: Side view, lowest to highest point
sizes.source: reported only (the rise, 121 mm, plus the section)

sizes.name: Across the bolt head and nut

features.text: Laminations show as stripes along the sides: broad pale ash between darker strips
Rectangular section with eased edges, deeper than wide at the butt (2 x 1.5 in), tapering to the grip
Flat through the straps, then rising about 4.75 in in a gentle S
Rounded grip end, no fitting on it
Two stainless side straps, round-ended round the pivot, running into the butt's sides
Pivot bolt with a hex head and washer one side, a nylock the other
Three carriage bolts through straps and butt: domed heads one side, nylocks the other
Varnished wood and stainless only: no aluminium box, no plastic knob

budget.note: hero is a Nanite part; build_kit makes the light copy at a quarter of the triangles
